ECE.kind: binary probability reliability, not max-class-confidence ECE

checkpoint_selection: validation scenario-macro BCE only; no AUROC, F1 or CAL outcomes used to select checkpoints
class_balance: exact 1:1 clean/pseudo among eligible paired parents; report realized rows, recipe counts and all skips; this is an artificial prevalence
evaluation_role: internal graph-development validation, not independent test performance

paired_statistics.conditional_seed_CI: mean(delta) +/- 2.776445105*SD(delta)/sqrt(5); t interval describes seed variability conditional on this fixed validation set, not population generalization

exact_sign_flip.claim: five pairs cannot reach p<0.05 with this exact two-sided test; no superiority claim from one seed or this fixed development set
exact_sign_flip.p: fraction of all 32 sign assignments with abs(mean(s*delta)) >= observed statistic - 1e-12

paired_statistics.failures: retain failed runs and reason; no seed replacement or best-seed selection; confirmatory-style aggregate marked incomplete if any planned pair fails
paired_statistics.per_seed: same samples/splits; record primary contrast and all oriented secondary differences

scenario_bootstrap.calculation: sample 3 scenario IDs with replacement; compute equal-scenario mean contrast, then mean across the five paired seeds; percentile interval [2.5,97.5]
scenario_bootstrap.scope: descriptive fragility check with only 3 validation scenarios; not independent test CI; never bootstrap individual ticks
scenario_bootstrap.unit: whole validation scenario, keeping all ticks, clean/pseudo pairs and methods together

paired_statistics.secondary_inference: exploratory only; no uncorrected multi-metric superiority claims; NoGraph contrasts descriptive

primary_endpoint.formula: arithmetic mean of AUROC over the 3 frozen graph-validation scenarios; ties contribute 0.5
primary_endpoint.name: scenario_macro_AUROC

secondary: scenario-macro average precision (AUPRC as stepwise average precision, not trapezoidal PR integration)

threshold.candidate_set: sorted unique validation p_corruption values union {0,1}
threshold.objective: maximize arithmetic mean of per-validation-scenario corruption F1
threshold.optimism: threshold selection and reported validation F1 use the same validation data; report as development statistics, not confirmatory evaluation
threshold.select_using: graph validation only, separately for each method and seed at its selected checkpoint

undefined: null plus explicit reason; no silent imputation, replacement scenario, or dropping failed seed
